breaking_changes.text: Network changed from br0 to one fixed address per port, which only stock-hmi.py sets up.
Apps before v2.0.11-RC2 can't install from a USB drive, so the panel couldn't be updated again from one.
Status packet and alarm bits changed: control and iot must run firmware from the same side of v2.0.11-RC2.
HMI variable table changed: regenerate hpc-gateway's conf with --remap, or it reads the wrong values.
Log drive format changed: log drives must be re-provisioned on the Diagnostic page, which erases them.
HMI variable table changed: regenerate hpc-gateway's conf with --remap, or it reads the wrong values.
HMI-HPC packets changed: control and iot must run firmware from the same side of v2.0.13, or the HMI can't reach the HPC.
HMI variable table changed: regenerate hpc-gateway's conf with --remap, or it reads the wrong values.
BMS Modbus registers and BACnet AI numbers changed: load FieldServer profile 8.00aA and remap the BMS points.
HMI variable table changed: regenerate hpc-gateway's conf with --remap, or it reads the wrong values.
Fault bits renumbered (Modbus/Defrost/Sensor Alarm removed): control and iot must run firmware from the same side of v2.0.16.
